cohort: The study included all live newborns admitted in the SNCU of a tertiary referral centre, excluding stillbirths.
finding: Out of 4200 live births, 494 babies had congenital malformations (452 major, 42 minor), with CVS anomalies being the most common major malformation (26%), and 70 babies died in the early neonatal period during the 3-month follow-up.
